text:
maria: Quick heads-up — starting Helios-30B-v0.9 onboarding. want to lock down a quant plan before we waste cycles.
ajay: Nice. What's initial perf/latency target?
maria: Target p50 < 350ms @ 8 token streaming on Dedicated 1xA100; unit cost target ~35% below fp16 baseline. Quality delta MMLU <= 1.5 points is the goal.
sasha: For gguf path we should try per-channel int8 symmetric first, then a fp8 fallback for attention/FFN if headroom is tight.
kevin: Agree. Also add a KV-cache sanity test — int8 can blow up activation ranges in transient steps.
cal-bot: note: calibration set suggestion = redwood-eval-small-llm-50 (50 multi-task prompts, mix of long-short contexts).
maria: Plan proposal: 1) run quick sensitivity (100 samples) for int8-perchannel and int8-ptq vs adaround? 2) if drop >2 MMLU, run fp8 hybrid (GGUF fp8 for matmuls only) 3) if streaming latency > target, tweak batching and async kv cache.
sasha: Sounds good. Add check: run single-batch emulation with prefix length 1024 to capture kv cache effect.
ajay: I'll reserve 4 A100s for calibration runs this afternoon.
kevin: Which eval harness?
maria: eval-bot will run the smoke suite: mmlusml, rouge-l on summarization subset, and a small regen/consistency probe.
eval-bot: running: mmlusml (50), summ-rouge (20), regen-consistency (30). Will post baseline fp16 numbers.
cal-bot: sample calibration command:
```
$ rwd-quant calibrate --model helios-30b-v0.9 \
  --mode int8 --scheme per-channel-symmetric \
  --calib-set redwood-eval-small-llm-50 --batch 8 \
  --out gguf/helios30b-int8.gguf \
  --kv-sanity --prefix-len 1024
```
maria: After that we'll do:
```
$ rwd-quant eval --model gguf/helios30b-int8.gguf --harness redwood-smoke --record metrics/helios30b-int8.json
```
sasha: If int8 MMLU drop <=1.5 and regen error < 3% then promote to fastpath; else try fp8-hybrid: fp8 for matmuls + int8 for rest.
kevin: Metrics we care about: MMLU, rouge-l, regen-stability, mean token latency, 95th pct latency, and memory footprint.
ajay: I'll log runs under /runs/helios30b/2026-03-20-calib. permission: eng-ml + eng-runtime.
maria: Timeline: calibration + smoke eval today, deeper 1k-sample sensitivity tomorrow. If green, prepare rollup to staging next week.
kevin: One more: add a short human read on 10 open-domain answers for hallucination check.
sasha: Can we also capture quantization-induced tokenization edgecases? sometimes quant changes softmax shape slightly.
maria: yes — include tokenization edgecases in regen-consistency probe.
eval-bot: queued: baseline fp16 run starting now. will post results as thread replies. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
ajay: ping me if the calibration fails with nan/inf; I can re-run with per-channel clamp. :thumbsup:
maria: thanks all — I'll post the canonical decision (int8 / fp8 / skip) and the checklist once smoke numbers are in.
